fresh_validation.policy: Fixed .25 quiet-only hybrid, incremental inference, rounded integer scores. Independent positions frozen before training and excluded from data generation. Strict fresh-validation accuracy improvement with no extra heuristic-correct regressions; test accuracy and regressions must not worsen. No retraining after reading this holdout.

protocol.training: Unchanged v8 architecture, .25 quiet-only residual blend, rounded full endpoint scores with straight-through gradients. Retain prior labels/rankings, prioritize confirmed errors, protect heuristic-correct rankings and anchor original corrections. One candidate only.
protocol.validation: Fresh teacher self-play from 30 book starts; opening-separated val/test; prior data/reviewed game aliases excluded. Freeze before training and reserve from new labels. Strict validation ranking gain, no extra regressions; test nonregression. No tuning on fresh test.
protocol.games: Only after fresh gate passes: 20 paired games against optimized 0%, then 20 against unchanged old nonincremental .25 quiet NN, same fresh starts, 250ms, depth8, 1000maxplies. If >=60% vs0 and >50% vsold with all complete/noerrors, extend vs0 to100 total games on40 fresh pairs. Report pilot and extension separately. No Stockfish or app promotion.
